attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Will Create Teeth System.

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below before build.

Fields:
- SetAttrsPosition: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- UprTeeth: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature.
- LwrTeeth: turn this ON/OFF depending on whether you want that feature.
- CtrlSize: numeric value that controls size/amount/intensity (default 4).
- SetUprParent: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- SetLwrParent: set the target node name.
- If left as default, the tool uses placeholder behavior for setup.
- Template parent examples: Jaw_Jnt, Head_Jnt, Head_Ctrl.
- Template attrs-position examples: Vis_Ctrl, Lips_Center_Ctrl, Jaw_Ctrl.

Tips:
- if a field says left/right or mirror, use it to generate the opposite side quickly.
